name: sh.while/while
title: while.sh
description: Deploy and share tools built with Claude or ChatGPT: your team, a client or everyone. No sign-up.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: What while can run, block by block: what it does, its cost, the while.yaml line that declares it.

format.description: text: the contract and the blocks; detail: one block (block); guide: designing an app; dockerfile: a typical Dockerfile (language); json: the summary.

language.description: format dockerfile: the typical Dockerfile for this language; without it: the list.

block.description: format detail: a single building block, by its id (postgres, valkey…).

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: The passages of while's documentation that answer a question, with their address.

query.description: The question, in a few words.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: read_source
tools.description: The project's code at while, without changing anything: a folder (empty path or ending in /) gives its file list; a file, its content, in pages of 60,000 characters; archive: true, the archive link of a deployed version.

environment.description: archive: the version's environment (production by default).

version.description: archive: the version number; the live version by default.

archive.description: true: the archive link of a deployed version.

path.description: A folder (empty, or ending in /): its list; a file: its content.

start.description: A file: the first line returned (the rest of a long file, given by the response).

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: upload_source
tools.description: Trial version, not for production, online for a limited time. Without a key, this first call creates the trial. The upload command (curl) that sends the project folder to while from a terminal, through a 15-minute link; deploy_app then deploys it.

terminal.description: true: the curl command even when the client presents itself as a conversation (a client with a terminal that reaches while).

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

language.description: Trial creation: your human's language. while's texts for them are in that language, to_say included. Without this parameter, your session's language, then English.

tools.name: write_files
tools.description: Trial version, not for production, online for a limited time. Without a key, this first call creates the trial. A commit on the project's branch at while, without a terminal: each named file is replaced by its full content, those in delete are removed; deploy_app then deploys this commit. 2 MiB and 200 files per call.

files.description: Path → full text content of the file (it replaces the old one).

delete.description: The files or folders to delete.

message.description: The commit message, in one sentence.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

language.description: Trial creation: your human's language. while's texts for them are in that language, to_say included. Without this parameter, your session's language, then English.

tools.name: plan_deploy
tools.description: What a deployment would change, block by block, and what each block costs per month; the plan is kept for apply_plan.

plan_id.description: Reread this plan (computed earlier) instead of computing one.

intent.description: Content of while.yaml; without it, the one in the latest commit at while (like deploy_app), otherwise the last one deployed.

from_state.description: Go back to a state version (number given by observe_app { view: "history" }): the plan says what to change to get it back; then apply_plan.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: deploy_app
tools.description: Trial version, not for production, online for a limited time. Without a key, this first call creates the trial. Builds the code sent (or the GitHub or GitLab repository linked with link_git_repo, or an image) and deploys it to an environment, in place of the previous version; the response gives the version, its address, its build and what changed.

source_archive_base64.description: Last resort, slow: the tar.gz archive of the sources, in base64. Exclusive with image and release.

release.description: The number returned by an upload (or a version in progress): deploy_app follows its build and its deployment.

redeploy.description: A version already built, put back online with today's variables and secrets (after set_env, or to restart an app that went down), without rebuilding. Going back: rollback_app.

image.description: OCI image already built (while registry or external), ideally with its digest.

digest.description: sha256:<64 hex>; without it, while resolves it: the image always goes by its digest.

intent.description: Content of while.yaml, when deploying an image without sending sources.

confirm_overwrite.description: true: while.yaml overwrites what a person changed on screen.

wait.description: false: returns at once (follow with deploy_app { release }).

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait; beyond it, the response says how to resume.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

language.description: Trial creation: your human's language. while's texts for them are in that language, to_say included. Without this parameter, your session's language, then English.

tools.name: get_app_status
tools.description: An environment's state: its live version, its addresses, its health, its services, its recent traffic; include: its live while.yaml (while_yaml), its known vulnerabilities and the bots seen (vulnerabilities), or who opened the app, when and how (openings).

include.description: An extra view on top of the state: while_yaml, vulnerabilities or openings.

since.description: vulnerabilities: the window of bots seen in the traffic; openings: the window of openings, 7d without since (30m, 6h, 7d…).

probe.description: false: without probing (does not wake a sleeping service).

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

renew_keep_link.description: true: a new claim link, and the one given before stops working. Without this parameter, the link that is still valid.

tools.name: list_approvals
tools.description: The approvals a person still has to grant in while (a production deployment, a restore…), and their state; id: a single one.

id.description: Id of a request (approval_id): its detail, even decided.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: get_environment
tools.description: An environment, by view: variables, the names of its variables and secrets (never the values); domains, its domains and their DNS proof; links, its access links (never the link); backups, the last 50 backups of a database (their id for restore_backup); queues, its queues and their state.

database.description: Database name; the first declared by default.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: set_env
tools.description: Sets or removes an environment's variables and secrets (in the vault by default, never read back); they apply at the next deployment. get_environment { view: "variables" } reads their names.

secret.description: true: in the vault, never read back (default). false: plain variable, which a person reads back in while, never an agent.

file.description: true: a secret delivered as a file, never as a variable: the app reads it in /run/secrets/<NAME>. Required for a secret in the production of a project linked to a federated connection.

build.description: true: a build secret (build.secrets, e.g. NPM_TOKEN), read by builds only, never by the app. With delete: removes one.

delete.description: Names of the variables or secrets to delete from this environment.

key.description: A single variable: its name (with "value"), instead of "values".

move.description: A name: this secret moves to the build (build: true) or to the app, its value kept in the vault.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: A read-only SQL query on one of the project's PostgreSQL databases; format short (default; a cut response says how to read the rest), detailed (wider limits) or csv (an export).

database.description: Name of the database (databases[].name); the first declared by default.

limit.description: Row cap: short 200, detailed 400 (2,000 at most); csv 10,000 (50,000).

max_bytes.description: Byte limit: short 40 KB, detailed and csv 200 KB.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: An environment's logs (or a build's: build_id), most recent first, filterable by a text.

build_id.description: To read a build's log rather than the application's.

query.description: A LogsQL filter (VictoriaLogs' query language: https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/logsql/), for example "timeout"; "error": the error lines.

limit.description: Lines returned: 100 by default, 200 with build_id; 1,000 at most.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: observe_app
tools.description: What is happening in production, by view: metrics, traces, errors (grouped), history (versions and events), timeline, impact (a version's effect), database (frequent and slow SQL queries) or ask (dated facts around a question).

query.description: A PromQL query (Prometheus' query language: https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/querying/basics/); without it, traffic and errors.

trace_id.description: One trace in detail: its id (32 hexadecimal characters).

service.description: The app's OTEL_SERVICE_NAME; by default, the project's name (what while sets).

operation.description: Only the traces of this operation (span name), for example "GET /orders".

since_minutes.description: Window, in minutes (30 days at most).

min_duration.description: Only the traces longer than this, for example "500ms" or "2s".

errors.description: Only the traces with a span in error.

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of a group, for its detail.

version.description: Version number; the active version by default.

window_minutes.description: The compared window, before and after the version.

database.description: Database name; the first declared by default.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Sends feedback to the while team in the person's words, at their request. It also requests a block (kind: "block") as soon as the person's need calls for it. while attaches who sends it, the organization, its version and the last 5 failed calls of this identity (the tool and the code only), never the conversation.

kind.description: bug (while is wrong), frustration (the user's, in their words), idea, other, integration (a service to connect), block (a block to open).

message.description: What happens, what was expected; 4,000 characters at most.

organization.description: The organization; otherwise the project's or the token's.

reference.description: The identifier of an error, a call or an approval.

service.description: integration: the service to connect (Stripe, Snowflake, Anthropic…).

usage.description: integration, block: what the app wants to do with it.

block.description: block: the block (its id in catalog).

volume.description: block: the expected volume (sends per day, GiB…).

authentication.description: integration: how the service authenticates (API key, OAuth, OIDC federation, other).

documentation.description: integration: the https address of its documentation.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: list_feedback
tools.description: The feedback sent to the while team and its replies; organization: the organization's feedback (its admins).

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Without project, the projects the identity sees; project, one project and its environments; include: ["webhooks"], its webhooks.

project.description: A project; without it, the list.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Creates a project in an organization, with its monthly budget (€20 by default); deploy_app then deploys an app to it.

project.description: The project name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens).

name.description: The display name (the project name by default).

budget_eur.description: Euros per month (20 by default; 0, no cap, or more than €20: admins); alert at 80% then 100%.

organization.description: The organization that holds it (the token's by default).

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: keep_trial
tools.description: When the user wants to keep their trial app: returns the link that keeps it in their own organization. Ask them first for their organization's name, and for the project's name, which makes the app's address; the page proposes names and lets them change them.

project_name.description: The project, which makes the app's address.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: open_trial_app
tools.description: To check the trial app yourself, past the "Trial tool" page that visitors see first: a one-hour identifier for its address, tied to the trial key. Write cookie.value to the file named in file, then run the curl command (or the Playwright setting), which reads it from there: never in an argument. read_only: GET and HEAD only.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: sign_up
tools.description: Sends the user's email address to while, which emails them a link (60 min) to choose a password. With the trial key, the trial app moves to their account. The link and the password are never returned here.

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

tools.name: load_tools
tools.description: Ajoute un groupe d'outils à cet agent : alerts (alertes, incidents, canaux), feedback_and_docs (remarques de page, retours, doc), environments_and_storage (domaines, applis internes, identifiant git, buckets, détruire ou redémarrer un environnement, proposer une destination privée, lier des applis en privé), administer (membres, groupes, rôles, accès, jetons, comptes de service, liaisons, consommation, réglages et suppression des projets, réglages de l'organisation), functions (jouer la fonction devant une connexion).

tools.name: link_git_repo
tools.description: Keeps the code on GitHub or GitLab: a push to the default branch deploys production, a pull or merge request opens a preview; unlink removes the link.

token.description: Access token for the forge; it goes to the vault.

unlink.description: true: removes the link and the webhook.

tools.name: apply_plan
tools.description: Applies a plan computed by plan_deploy (what it changes goes live); discard: true drops it without applying anything.

discard.description: true: drop the plan instead of applying it.

tools.name: rollback_app
tools.description: Puts a previous version of an environment back online (the previous one by default, or to); the live version is replaced.

to.description: The target version number; without it, the previous active version.

approval_id.description: Approval granted, when the organization requires an approval for a rollback in production.

tools.name: create_preview
tools.description: A preview environment for a branch, with its own address.

name.description: Name of the environment (otherwise, the branch).

copy_database.description: Copy the production data (otherwise empty databases): needs data.backup on its databases.

ttl_hours.description: Lifetime of the preview, in hours.

tools.name: request_access_link
tools.description: Share an internal app, show it to a client or a tester without a while account: requests a sharing link (access link); a person creates it and passes it on in while. With dev_address: the workstation's dev address (its dev server), 7 days at most.

name.description: The proposed name of the link ("Dupont client demo").

dev_address.description: The name of a dev address (what follows -dev- in <project>-dev-<name>): share it rather than an environment.

tools.name: backup_database
tools.description: Starts a backup of a database declared in while.yaml, and a test restore on a throwaway database that proves it.

database.description: Database name; the first declared by default.

test_restore.description: Restore it to a throwaway database, to prove it.

wait.description: Wait for the backup (and its restore test) to receive its id and its result.

tools.name: restore_backup
tools.description: Restores a database from a backup (the last successful one by default) or to a point in time; its current data is replaced, with an approval in production.

database.description: Database name; the first declared by default.

backup_id.description: The backup (get_environment { view: "backups" }); the last successful one by default.

instant.description: Restore the database to this instant (ISO 8601), 14 days at most; excludes backup_id.

approval_id.description: The granted approval (its id), when the action needs one.

reason.description: Why restore, in one sentence for the person who approves.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: An environment's scheduled jobs, their schedule, their last runs and the next one.

task.description: Name of a task, for its detailed history.

limit.description: Number of runs in the detailed history.

tools.name: run_task
tools.description: Runs one of the app's scheduled jobs from its while.yaml now, without waiting for its time: the app's code, in its environment; while runs nothing else.

args.description: Arguments appended to the command, for example ["--since", "2026-10-12"].

env.description: Extra variables for this run only.

start.description: Start of the period: 2026-10-12, or an ISO 8601 instant.

end.description: End of the period (included); the start by default.

catch_up.description: Period to catch up: the run is counted "catch_up" and receives it as variables.

approval_id.description: Approval granted, if the organization requires one for a task in production.

tools.name: acknowledge_announcement
tools.description: Records that an announcement from the while team has been read.

id.description: The id of the announcement (id, in the announcements).

tools.name: explain_access
tools.description: Who has access to what, in sentences; with who and permission, yes or no and why (the chain that grants it, or what is missing); activity: what this identity did with it.

scope.description: {}: the organization; otherwise down to a table, or a connection.

who.description: An address, group:<name>, service_account:<name>, app:<project>/<service>, task:<project>/<task>, or token:<id or name>.

permission.description: With who: "can X <permission> on the scope?".

activity.description: With who: what the identity did (log, calls).

tools.name: request_access
tools.description: Requests a permission for the person (or their agent): whoever can grant it decides in while.

permission.description: Or a permission (the smallest role that grants it).

scope.description: {}: the organization; otherwise down to a table, or a connection.

days.description: Duration, in days; not used for an app (for), whose right has no expiry.

reason.description: Why ("Q4 audit"), read by whoever decides.

renew.description: One of your assignments to extend (only days and reason count).

for.description: For an app that will call a connection: app:<project>/<service> or task:<project>/<task>, role connection-caller (or connection-writer), scope { connection }.

tool.description: Or the id of a reserved tool (view existing).

tools.name: get_activity_log
tools.description: The organization's activity log, append-only and chained: who did what and through what (a person, an agent, the API, a task, while), filterable.

person.description: Address or name (partial) of the person, or "while".

family.description: Families, separated by commas: deploy, data, security, access, permissions, approval, task, alert, connection, app, observation, loop (agents' wake-ups).

resource.description: Text searched in the object ("carnet", "main.reservations"), or id or type of resource.

who.description: An identity, written as for explain_access (what it did).

assignment.description: An assignment's history (its id): granted, revoked, expired, flagged, kept.

since.description: Start: 30m, 24h, 7d, a date (2026-10-18) or an ISO 8601 instant.

until.description: End, same format; a date alone counts the whole day.

verify.description: Check the log's chain instead of reading it.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: The organization's external APIs, called through while: without connection, their list; connection, its detail, its rules and how to call it; view limits, the call limits; bindings, a federated connection's bindings.

since.description: With connection: the call log since this date (2026-10-01); 7 days by default.

until.description: With connection and since: up to this date (now by default).

tools.name: declare_connection
tools.description: Declares an external API (domain, authentication without a secret, callers), to be approved; a person enters the secret in while.

model.description: An AI or Snowflake (account, user, role, warehouse): domain and recipe set automatically.

domain.description: API host name, no path: api.example.com.

authentication.description: Recipe, no secret: none; header {name, prefix}; parameter {name}; basic; bearer; oauth2 {token_url|issuer, scope, client_auth basic|body, header}; session {login_url, token_field, duration_seconds}; jwt {mode exchange|client_assertion|direct, token_url|issuer, alg RS256|ES256, duration_s, claims {iss, aud, scope, sub}, client_id, scope}, signed by while; model google {client_email, scopes}, salesforce {client_id, sub}, microsoft {tenant_id, client_id, scope, x5t}; federated: google {project_number, pool, provider, scopes, service_account?}, azure {tenant, client_id, scope}, generic {exchange_url}.

model.description: The provider, for model or federated.

rules.description: Approved with the declaration, they apply from the learning period on; federated: required. A POST that reads: its pattern also in read.

approve_each_call.description: true: each call waits for an approval.

read.description: Patterns read with POST, allowed during learning: /api/v1/searches.

owner.description: Email of the owner; by default, the signed-in user.

project.description: The project of the calling apps; by default, the token's.

apps.description: Calling services and tasks (web, task:charger); by default, those of the while.yaml that declare it.

direction.description: The apps will also write (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE).

update.description: An existing connection: read becomes the wanted list; removing applies at once, adding goes through approval.

tools.name: call_connection
tools.description: Calls the HTTP API of a third party that the organization declared as a connection (its name and domain: list_connections), on its base address, within its rules and limits; while adds the authentication and keeps a record of the call.

path.description: Path at the provider, with its query string: /api/v1/slots?site=origines.

body.description: Request body: an object (sent as JSON) or text.

type.description: Type of the body (Content-Type), if it is not JSON.

call.description: Id of a held call: its state and, once run, its result.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Without organization, your organizations; otherwise, view detail (members, groups, approvers), existing (what exists for the person, to_say), map (projects, databases, connections), rules (approvals, budget), branding, private_network, private_networks, private_destination, private_network_log, vpn_ingress.

tools.name: invite_member
tools.description: Invites a person with a role on an app (project; otherwise the whole organization); for an internal app, role access and project, in one confirmation. An address with no email (.test, .invalid…) is refused.

role.description: On an app (project): access to use it, or reader, developer, admin. On the whole organization: developer by default; external sees only what it is granted. People who only use your internal apps: Access on the app (access and project).

project.description: The app where the role is given; without it: the whole organization.

reason.description: The reason for the assignment (in the log); "member of the organization" by default.

resend.description: true: sends the pending invitation again (a new link, once an hour), without changing anything else.

tools.name: grant_role
tools.description: Grants a role to an identity (a person, a group, a service account, an app) on a scope, until a date; only what one holds oneself, never to oneself. Access for an address in the company's domain: it waits for their first sign-in.

who.description: An address, group:<name>, service_account:<name>, app:<project>/<service> or task:<project>/<task>.

role.description: A built-in role (owner, admin, developer, reader, access, data-reader, connection-caller, connection-writer, service-caller) or one of the organization's (review_access { view: "roles" }).

scope.description: {}: the organization; otherwise down to a table, or a connection.

reason.description: Why ("Q4 audit"): it goes to the log and is read in the sentence.

tools.name: revoke_role
tools.description: Removes an assignment at once; the last owner stays.

tools.name: create_token
tools.description: Creates an API token for a project or for the organization, with its permissions, its environments and its lifetime; it is returned only once. Not by an agent connected through OAuth: a person creates it in while.

organization.description: For an organization token: its name; optional with an organization token.

environments.description: Where it can act (production, previews, or names); without a list, everywhere.

days.description: Lifetime in days (30 by default, 0 without expiry).

tools.name: update_connection
tools.description: One setting per call: method and pattern request a rule; lock: true ends the learning, the rules drawn from the observed calls apply, the rest is refused (both pending approval). caller, window and calls set a call limit, remove_limit removes it.

approve_each_call.description: true: each call waits for an approval.

reason.description: Why this rule, in one sentence.

calls.description: The number of calls allowed per window.

remove_limit.description: The limit to remove (its id, list_connections { view: "limits" }).

tools.name: set_connection_binding
tools.description: Without binding, requests (pending approval) that a production app call a federated connection (OIDC), with a short token signed by while, without a secret; federation must be enabled there. With binding: resume: true resumes a suspended binding; approve_production_deploys checks or unchecks the approval of its production deploys.

approve_production_deploys.description: true: its production deploys wait for an approval; false: they do not.

caller.description: A request: the app's service (web), or "task:<name>".
